subject.title: fix(extensions): bound extension source read with size cap

question: Should a symlinked extension path remain eligible for the existing native-import source-scan path, or is routing it through Jiti an accepted compatibility change?
rationale: The new helper intentionally rejects symlinks, while the prior raw read followed them; source and test evidence supplied for this PR proves the oversized-file path but not equivalence for symlinked extensions.

options.title: Preserve native symlink behavior
options.body: Adapt the bounded-read boundary or loader logic so supported symlinked regular files retain the prior native-import decision, with focused regression coverage.

options.title: Accept Jiti fallback for symlinks
options.body: Document and test that symlinked extensions intentionally bypass native source scanning and load through Jiti.

recommendation.title: Preserve native symlink behavior
recommendation.body: Adapt the bounded-read boundary or loader logic so supported symlinked regular files retain the prior native-import decision, with focused regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product and compatibility boundary for extension loading rather than a contributor-follow-up task.
